summary: Urgent.ly Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a tender offer and merger with Agero, Inc. and its subsidiary. Under the Merger Agreement, Purchaser acquired all outstanding common shares at $5.50 per share in cash. Approximately 58.7% of outstanding voting shares were tendered, satisfying the Minimum Condition. The merger closed on April 28, 2026, with Urgent.ly surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. This going-private transaction follows the tender offer that expired on April 24, 2026. Key conditions included regulatory approvals and the tender threshold. Post-merger, the company's stock will be delisted, as shares were acquired for cash and the company is now privately held. Watch for any appraisal rights or litigation from dissenting shareholders.
